# infoblox_infra_host (Data Source)

Retrieves information about existing Infoblox InfraHost from the UDDI backend.

## Example Usage

### UDDI Backend

```terraform
// Retrieve Infra Hosts filtered by an attribute
data "infoblox_infra_host" "example_by_attribute" {
  filters = {
    "display_name" = "example_host"
  }
}

// Retrieve Infra Hosts filtered by tag
data "infoblox_infra_host" "example_by_tag" {
  tag_filters = {
    Site = "location-1"
  }
}

// Retrieve all Infra Hosts
data "infoblox_infra_host" "example_all" {}
```


<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `filters` (Map of String) Filter are used to return a more specific list of results. Filters can be used to match resources by specific attributes.
- `limit` (Number) Number of results to return per page. Defaults to 1000. Only applicable for UDDI backend.
- `paging` (Number) Enable (1) or disable (0) paging for the data source query. Enabled by default. When disabled, only a single page of results is retrieved.
- `tag_filters` (Map of String) Tag Filters are used to return a more specific list of results filtered by tags. Only applicable for UDDI backend.

### Read-Only

- `results` (Attributes List) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--results))

<a id="nestedatt--results"></a>
### Nested Schema for `results`

Read-Only:

- `id` (String) The resource identifier.
- `uddi` (Attributes) UDDI backend-specific fields. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--results--uddi))

<a id="nestedatt--results--uddi"></a>
### Nested Schema for `results.uddi`

Read-Only:

- `configs` (Attributes List) The list of Host-specific configurations for each Service deployed on this Host. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--results--uddi--configs))
- `description` (String) The description of the Host (optional).
- `display_name` (String) The name of the Host (unique).
- `host_type` (String) The type of Host.  Should be one of: 1. NIOS , 2. NIOS HA, 3. NIOS-X VM , 4. NIOS-X Appliance, 5. NIOS-X Container, 6. CNIOS
- `ip_address` (String) The IP address of the Host.
- `ip_space` (String) The IP Space of the Host.
- `legacy_id` (String) The legacy Host object identifier.
- `location_id` (String) The resource identifier.
- `mac_address` (String) The MAC address of the Host.
- `maintenance_mode` (String)
- `ophid` (String) The unique On-Prem Host ID generated by the On-Prem device and assigned to the Host once it is registered and logged into the Infoblox Cloud.
- `pool_id` (String) The resource identifier.
- `serial_number` (String) The unique serial number of the Host.
- `tags` (Map of String) Tags associated with this Host.
- `tags_all` (Map of String) All tags including inherited values.
- `timezone` (String) The timezone of the Host.

<a id="nestedatt--results--uddi--configs"></a>
### Nested Schema for `results.uddi.configs`

Read-Only:

- `id` (String) The resource identifier.
- `service_id` (String) The resource identifier.
- `service_type` (String) The type of the Service deployed on the Host (`dns`, `cdc`, etc.).
